provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Lairs and Lost Chambers rulebook (via RulesPal)

modules.name: Lairs and Lost Chambers
modules.note: First game: shuffle the new tiles and cards into the top half of their stacks.

modules.name: Underworld
modules.note: Front side of the Underworld starting tile is recommended for a first game.

modules.name: Underworld: back side of its starting tile
modules.note: Moves the Monkey Shrine down to the Underworld.

steps.text: Clank! board to one side; Dragon marker on the Rage Track space for {n} players
Adventuring Party side board next to the Clank! board for the Dragon's rage and the health of players 5 and 6; Dragon marker on the first space of its Rage Track
Shuffle the {n} facedown as a stack in the Bank

cases.value: 32 Depths tiles (22 + 10 Lairs and Lost Chambers)

steps.text: Shuffle the 6 Underworld Depths tiles and box 3 unseen. Shuffle the {n}, take the top 7, shuffle the 3 Underworld ones into those and put the 10 back on top, as a stack in the Bank

cases.value: 32 Depths tiles (22 + 10 Lairs and Lost Chambers)

steps.text: Shuffle the {n} other square tiles (safe tiles), box {b} unseen, put {k} on top of the Depths stack
steps.note: Lairs and Lost Chambers adds 2 safe tiles; with Underworld only 3 tiles come before the Depths

steps.text: Shuffle the 7 Underworld tiles facedown as a separate stack next to the square tiles
Gold, Lockpicks, 5 white Ghost cubes and the Dragon bag with 24 black cubes in the Bank
5 monster tokens in the Bank: 3 Living Statues, Medusa and the Sphinx
steps.ref: Lairs and Lost Chambers rulebook: Setup

steps.text: Undercoins, the 8 harpy tokens and the 5 ladder tokens in the Bank
7 Artifacts stacked faceup by value, 5 on top, 20 at the bottom
Add the 10, 15, 20 and 25 Adventuring Party Artifacts into the stack (theirs above same-value ones); not the 30
Shuffle major secrets, minor secrets and prisoners facedown, each kind separately
Shuffle the Underworld major secrets, minor secrets and prisoners in with the tokens of the same kind
Market Board: 2 Backpacks, 2 Blood Amulets, 3 Burglar's Kits, 3 Crowns (10 on top, 8 at the bottom)

Underworld Market Board instead, in two rows: top row 2 Backpacks, 2 Blood Amulets, 3 Burglar's Kits, 3 Crowns (10 on top, 8 at the bottom) and the River Lamp; bottom row the 5 Underworld market items
Add Adventuring Party Market items except the Master Key; use its other components and side board
Starting tile in the center, either side up, with room around it
Underworld starting tile in your playing space, front side up, with room between it and the Catacombs starting tile
Underworld starting tile in your playing space, back side up, with room between it and the Catacombs starting tile

On the Underworld starting tile: the Magic Lyre (16-point artifact); the 3 artifact enhancers (2x on top) with the Underworld Guardian marker; the 3 Imp Assistants (4 on top); a harpy token from the Bank in its harpy room
A random prisoner faceup in the marked prison room of the Underworld starting tile (not freed: no immediate effect)
3 Monkey Idols on the Monkey Shrine of the Underworld starting tile; cover the Catacombs Monkey Shrine with the replacement token
3 Monkey Idols on the Monkey Shrine room
{n} Mastery tokens near the Crypt
Reserve: Goblin card plus Mercenary, Explore and Secret Tome stacks
Underworld Guardian card in the Reserve next to the Goblin
Shuffle the 50 Lairs and Lost Chambers cards into the Dungeon Deck
steps.ref: Lairs and Lost Chambers rulebook: Setup

steps.text: Shuffle the 50 Underworld cards into the Dungeon Deck
Shuffle the 35 Adventuring Party cards into the Dungeon Deck
Shuffle the Dungeon Deck; deal {n} faceup as the Dungeon Row, replacing Dragon Attack cards (reshuffle those)
Shuffle the 22 fate cards; fate deck next to the Dungeon Deck
Each player: 30 Clank! cubes of their color; pawn on the Crypt of the starting tile
Players 5 and 6: cubes and pawns of the two Adventuring Party colors
Each player takes {n} Lockpicks
Starting deck: 6 Burgles, 2 Stumbles, 1 Sidestep, 1 Scramble; shuffle and draw 5
Optional: everyone plays an Adventuring Party character instead, with its board, its own starting deck and its tokens
Each player takes an Underworld reference card
First game: each player takes 1 undercoin from the Bank
Starting Clank! on the board: 1st player 3, 2nd 2, 3rd 1, 4th 0
Players 5 and 6 add no Clank!; player 5 takes 1 Gold, player 6 takes 2 Gold
Knocked out without an artifact, or in the Depths, scores 0 points
Trophies (defeated lair monsters, TROPHY cards) stay in your supply: their effect lasts and each lair monster is worth 1 point at the end
steps.ref: Lairs and Lost Chambers rulebook: Trophies

steps.text: Entering Medusa's Lair: fight her (needs a Secret Tome played this turn) or take 2 damage
steps.ref: Lairs and Lost Chambers rulebook: Lairs

steps.text: Starting your turn in the Underworld costs 1 undercoin, or +2 Clank! if you have none
steps.ref: Underworld rulebook: The Underworld Takes a Toll

steps.text: Knocked out in the Underworld also scores 0 points
At the end: an artifact enhancer multiplies your best artifact (rounded up), an Imp Assistant scores its number per Secret Tome, fate cards and undercoins score too
The sneakiest player (or a random one) goes first
